author: Animalogic
description:
Nature's untitled project. The default mammal. The Potato-shaped wawa. These are just some of the names hyraxes get called every day. But we've been underestimating this little mammal. Their biology hides traits from a time when Africa was an isolated country. They're amazing singers. They're mentioned in ancient books as wise animals. And they're communal toilets are time machines that let us look at the environment thousands of years ago. So we're standing up for one of the must bullied and misunderstood animals in Africa: The hyrax.
